visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Exceptions Instead of Returning null
visualizerParams.problemDescription: parseAge returns null on failure and the caller has to check for it. Throw an error and handle it with try / catch / finally. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A null return value can be ignored by accident, and every caller needs its own check. An exception cannot be ignored silently, carries a message, and the happy path reads without error handling.
